en-US.description: A modern task manager and system monitor for Windows 11, built with WinUI 3.
en-US.longDescription:
Pulse is a task manager and system monitor for Windows 11 with a modern glass design (or the
classic look), live CPU, memory, GPU, per-disk and network graphs, detailed hardware info
(RAM modules and speed, CPU cores and cache, GPU VRAM and driver, disk PCIe generation and
health), per-process details (network, disk, GPU, efficiency mode), startup app management,
Windows services, hardware sensors, a memory optimizer, a network connections and open ports
viewer, a file unlocker, a desktop widget and live tray icons.
Fully local: no telemetry and no accounts.
en-US.name: Pulse
